title: The Awakening
mission: The flag is in a hidden files in your home directory. Find a way to see the hidden file and fetch the flag.
hint: Read the man page for ls command like this: man ls. Read it and you will find the answer!

title: The Reading Room
mission: Navigate into 'archives/classified/2026' and read the secret document.
hint: Use 'man -k <keyword>' for keyword based searches. Search for keywords like changing directories / printing contents / standard output

title: Ink and Paper
mission: The server launch daemon is awaiting configuration in 'dispatch.conf'. Use a command to write the required configuration keys. Check the instructions file for the configuration keys. Once edited the file, execute './verify_dispatch' to reveal your flag!
hint: Check the man page of bash, read it and find if there is anything related to writing output, redirection of data

title: Housekeeping
mission: An archive payload was misplaced as 'staging/temp_payload.dat'. Move it to 'production/app_payload.dat', and create a duplicate backup copy at 'backups/app_payload.dat'. Run './check_production' to verify!
hint: Use 'man -k <keyword>' for keyword based searches. Search man pages for keywords like copy files / copy / move files

title: Excavation
mission: The storage area 'sandbox/clutter' is full of junk. Locate 'sandbox/clutter/secret_*.txt' amidst the clutter, create the directory 'sandbox/secure_vault', and move the key into it. Run './verify_vault' to decrypt the vault and reveal the flag!
hint: Use 'man -k <keyword>' for keyword based searches. Search man pages for keywords like directories / make / remove

title: Compass and Map
mission: A diagnostic binary 'sec-beacon' is installed on the system. It requires its own installation path as an argument to authenticate. Find where this binary is located on the system and provide the location back to it to get the flag.
hint: Use 'man -k <keyword>' for keyword based searches. Search the man pages for keywords like: locate binary / binary / search path / locate program

title: Disguised Identities
mission: Inspect the files inside 'suspects/'. Files inside the suspects have wrong extensions added. All files have misleading extensions (.png, .mp3, .pdf, .bin, .tar). Exactly one file is an ASCII text file containing the mission flag. Find a way to detect the actual type of the file rather than the file extension.
hint: Use 'man -k <keyword>' for keyword based searches. Search the man pages for keywords like: file type / file / determining file content type

title: Head and Shoulders
mission: The telemetry stream 'sensor_stream.log' contains 1,000 lines of data. The mission flag is recorded precisely at line 500. Use any commands but we recommend to use 'head' and 'tail' to extract line 500!
hint: Feed the output from head back to tail and do some combined processing. Try reading the bash to see if they have any way to link output of one command to another. Use that

title: By the Numbers
mission: The folder 'transcripts/' holds multiple candidate files. The authentic classified debrief has exactly 42 lines. There is a tool called wc which can do some word and file related checks. Read the man page for that and find the actual file which has 42 lines.
hint: Visit man page of 'wc' command, check for available option related to line counts

title: The Lone Survivor
mission: The file 'transaction_hashes.txt' contains 200 transaction tokens with duplicates. Exactly one token is unique without any duplicate. Find a command which helps to identify the duplicates and use that to identify the proper token.
hint: Use 'man -k <keyword>' for keyword based searches. Search the man pages for keywords like: repeated lines / report lines / sort

title: Cipher Shift
mission: An intercepted transmission 'intercepted.enc' was scrambled using a classic ROT13 cipher. Decipher the message using 'tr' to reveal the plaintext flag!
hint: Ensure to read more about ROT13 and then try how can we use the tr command through man tr.

title: The Log Whisperer
mission: The 'logs/' directory contains dozens of access logs with thousands of web requests. Find the suspicious entry tagged with error code 'ERR_LEAK_9918' and extract the leaked flag!
hint: Find a command which can help us to search through files. Use 'man -k <keyword>' for keyword based searches. Search the man pages for keywords like: search for patterns / match pattern / search

title: Needle in the Haystack
mission: The 'storage/' directory contains deeply nested folders and decoy files. Find the file named 'access.key' that has a file size greater than 50 bytes using 'find' to discover the flag!
hint: Read more and indepth features of find using man find command.

title: The Vault
mission: A compressed archive 'classified_vault.tar.gz' has arrived. Decompress and unpack the archive using 'tar' to inspect 'vault_data/credentials.txt' and retrieve the flag!
hint: Read more about tar command using the man tar command. Just read you will figure it out!

title: Master of the Shell
mission: Capstone Challenge! Analyze the telemetry file 'network_traffic.csv'. Extract the client IP addresses (column 2), filter by port '443', count occurrences with 'uniq -c', and find the IP with the highest traffic volume. Once identified, run './report_attacker <IP>' to earn the master flag!
hint: If you came this far, you know what to do! That's right it is in man pages, but this time it won't be a single command, But cocktail of few items so start hacking!
